ranking_quantity: late_out_value: the absolute home-minus-away difference of the absence value newly ruled Out between the six-hour cutoff and thirty minutes before tip-off. Not the total value ruled Out: two teams losing the same value rank near zero.

strict.note: 2025-26 holdout, priced games where both teams had filed at six hours; models trained on the same restriction of 2023-24 and 2024-25. The block the figure shows.

all_priced.note: 2025-26 holdout, every game with an opening and a closing price; models trained on 2023-24 and 2024-25. Reported beside the strict block as the original analysis.

late_window_note: league/scripts/p6_ds_example_aggregate.py, run on the merged report series: the collected series of league/public/sources.csv plus the 1,787 files of league/public/sources_late_window.csv, which cover the window from 90 minutes before each game day's last tip-off to the tip itself. The frozen counterpart without the `_late_window` suffix is the collected-series run that the journal manuscript reports. Quantities at six hours and at ninety minutes are identical in the two by construction, and results/paper2_late_window.json records that check.
